A white or almost white, crystalline powder. Practically insoluble in water; slightly solu- ble in alcohol and in dichloromethane. Protect from light. USP 31 (Prednisolone Acetate). A white to practically white, odourless, crystalline powder. Practically insoluble in water; sol- uble 1 in 120 of alcohol; slightly soluble in acetone and in chlo- roform. Store at a temperature of 25°, excursions permitted be- tween 15° and 30°.
